short.text: Jerome Long is a developmental defensive tackle who spent the 2013 season on Jacksonville's practice squad and, after signing a reserve/future contract in February 2014, returned to the practice squad at the final cuts. He offers size and a basic power role inside, but defeating blocks and playing with disciplined technique, from his hand use to his gap control, are bigger questions than his strength.
